front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏     系列 《39》

en: A few fishing lights, the traveler's boat sailing far away
Only the river moon keeps watch over the bell's toll
Guarding the frost-cold ancient temple

points.zh:
月落烏啼霜滿天，江楓漁火對愁眠。
姑蘇城外寒山寺，夜半鐘聲到客船。
--唐。張繼 《楓橋夜泊》
points.en:
The moon sets, crows cry, frost fills the sky; river maples and fishing fires face my sleepless sorrow.
Outside the city of Gusu, at Hanshan Temple, the sound of the midnight bell reaches the traveler's boat.
-- Tang dynasty. Zhang Ji, 'Night Mooring at Maple Bridge'

en: When I remember, you
Now and then still as a valley
Now and then starlight pierces through cloud and mist

zh: 來蘋果樹下找我吧，牛頓説
en: Come find me under the apple tree, said Newton
Let's talk about it, 3.141592...... pi
Taste it, apple pie, apple pie
In the afternoon, reading a book
A red leaf, falling upon
That page with no title

points.zh: 李梅樹 (1902-1983) 台北三峽人， 為台灣近代著名西畫家，美術先驅，留學東京美術學校西洋畫科，不論是人物、風景或靜物，皆能融合寫實主義與印象主義於一爐。從留日階段的人物肖像、台府展時期的林溪風景，到戰後描繪大眾日常生活，創作方向多元。題材大多來自三峽故鄉景色與人物，傳達自然真實及親切的情感。此外，李梅樹投身地方行政、主持三峽祖師廟之重建，數十年如一日，廣受群眾愛戴，樹立大家長之親民形象，在當時畫家中甚為少見。繁忙公務之外，卻能不忘創作，且積極參與國家展覽及美術人才養成，推廣美育不遺餘力。
points.en: Li Mei-shu (1902–1983), born in Sanxia, Taipei, was a renowned modern Western-style painter of Taiwan and a pioneer of fine art, who studied Western painting at the Tokyo School of Fine Arts. Whether depicting figures, landscapes, or still life, he was able to blend realism and impressionism into one. From the figure portraits of his years studying in Japan, to the landscapes of the Sanxia stream during the Taiwan/Prefectural Exhibition period, to his postwar depictions of everyday popular life, his creative directions were diverse. Most of his subject matter was drawn from the scenery and people of his hometown Sanxia, conveying a natural, true, and warmly intimate feeling. In addition, Li Mei-shu devoted himself to local administration and oversaw the reconstruction of the Sanxia Zushi Temple, a task he pursued unwaveringly for decades, winning wide public affection and establishing an image as a patriarchal figure close to the people — a rarity among painters of his time. Despite his busy public duties, he never neglected his art, and actively participated in national exhibitions and the training of art talent, tirelessly promoting art education.

en: That year, the kapok flowers bloomed
Red for half the sky, white for half the sky
In the wind, long hair sways
Having once seen the vast sea, all other waters seem lacking
Where the heart grows still
That is the final home

points.zh:
曾經滄海難為水，除卻巫山不是雲。
取次花叢懶回顧，半緣修道半緣君。
--唐。元稹 《離思》
「 趙真也揮手道别，望著漸漸遠去的舟影，悄然露出微笑。她終於看清了自己的歸宿; 那就和葉舟的歸宿一樣，是在滔滔江水之中，天涯浮雲之際。所謂歸宿，就是没有歸宿，也就是她的歸宿。此後的趙真，便和之前的趙真一樣，在如江水般不肯稍歇的歲月流轉之中，在春花秋月，夏風冬雪的交替之中，满足而堅定地守在人生最光燦亮麗的一刻 。」
--《杏花渡傳説》 鄭丰武俠短篇精選集    2018，P 249
points.en:
Having once seen the vast ocean, other waters seem hardly worth the name; having once seen the clouds of Mount Wu, other clouds seem nothing at all.
Even passing through beds of flowers, I no longer care to look back — half because of my cultivation of the Way, half because of you.
-- Tang dynasty. Yuan Zhen, 'Thoughts of Parting'
"Zhao Zhen too waved farewell, and watching the boat's shadow gradually recede into the distance, quietly let a smile appear. She had finally seen clearly where she truly belonged; it was the same as where the leaf-like boat belonged — amid the surging river waters, at the edge of drifting clouds at the horizon. What is called a destination is, in truth, having no fixed destination — and that, itself, was her destination. From then on, Zhao Zhen was just as she had been before: amid the ceaseless flow of the years, like the river that never rests, amid the alternation of spring flowers and autumn moons, summer winds and winter snows, she held on, content and resolute, to the most brilliant and radiant moment of her life."
-- from 'The Legend of Apricot Blossom Ferry,' a collection of Zheng Feng's selected wuxia short stories, 2018, p. 249

en: Autumn, the harvest
The chrysanthemum in the dusk, and also
The mood stirred by the reeds' reflection
Waves heading east
Washing away a hundred generations of passing travelers
The river moon quietly watches this fleeting life, dreamlike

points.zh:
江天一色無纖塵，皎皎空中孤月輪。
江畔何人初見月，江月何年初照人。
人生代代無窮已，江月年年望相似。
不知江月待何人，但見長江送流水。
--唐 。張若虚 《春江花月夜》
points.en:
The river and sky share a single color, free of the faintest speck of dust; alone in the vast sky hangs a solitary, glowing wheel of moon.
Who beside the river first saw the moon? In what year did the river moon first shine upon a person?
Human life passes on, generation after generation without end; the river moon, year after year, looks just the same.
I know not for whom the river moon waits; I only see the Yangtze River sending its flowing waters onward.
-- Tang dynasty. Zhang Ruoxu, 'A Moonlit Night on the Spring River'

en: Years turn and flow, worldly affairs shift with time
There is always a patch of moonlight
Light up the dream

points.zh:
《 城裡的月光 》
詞/曲：陳佳明    編曲：吳慶隆
每個心上某一個地方
總有個記憶揮不散
每個深夜某一個地方
總有著最深的思量
世間萬千的變化
愛把有情的人分兩端
心若知道靈犀的方向
哪怕不能夠朝夕相伴
城裡的月光把夢照亮
請溫暖他心房
看透了人間聚散
能不能多點快樂片段
城裡的月光把夢照亮
請守候他身旁
若有一天能重逢
讓幸福撤滿整個夜晚
points.en:
"Moonlight Over the City"
Lyrics/Music: Chen Chia-ming; Arranged by: Wu Ching-lung
Somewhere in every heart
there is always a memory that will not fade
Somewhere in every deep night
there is always the deepest longing
The countless changes of this world
let love pull those who feel it to opposite ends
If the heart knows the direction of that unspoken understanding
even if the two cannot be together morning and night
Let the city's moonlight light up the dream
please warm his heart
Having seen through the world's partings and reunions
can there not be a few more moments of happiness?
Let the city's moonlight light up the dream
please watch over him
If one day we can meet again
let happiness fill the whole night
